scope.entry: buildRules + applyRules; only neutral in-memory strings

assertions: False protected openers/closers inside closed comments, quoted attributes, and closed typed fences do not change lexical state.
True unclosed protected scopes spanning closed fences still suppress bubbles and candidates.
Different protected tags remain independent: partial closure suppresses dialogue; complete closure restores it.
Same-tag nesting retains conservative protection after closing markup.
Each protected tag supports uppercase/lowercase closure combinations under legacy gm flags.
Suppressed inputs remain byte-for-byte unchanged; no inert candidates leak.

performance.note: One independent process sample; this is a regression review, not the official performance budget suite.

acceptance: Source fixture assertions only. Real SillyTavern import/settings and rendering acceptance belong to the separate host replay evidence.
